title: Carnival parade job before leaving, on baritone horn
summary: His last big New Orleans job was a band for the King's Chariot in the carnival parade.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: They did that then, too. I wondered if they just stuck to the lead. Did you hear any parades when you were a boy? Can you remember? Of course, the Mardi Gras parades, I guess, you can't miss those.
Oh, my gosh, yes, parades and funerals with bands.
And the very last job that I booked before I left there was the carnival parade of that year. I had a band that played for the King's Chariot. That was my last big job before I came to Chicago.
Was that on the street or the carnival ball?
On the street. On the street. Oh, no, we never played any of the ball.
What did you play in the parade? Sax?
No, at that time I was playing baritone horn.
